meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器代理调用本地大模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想让容器中的智能体调用本地运行的大模型
copy.tagline_en: Enable your container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your containerized agent to use local AI models

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 能把任务交给本机 Atomic Chat 桌面应用里的本地模型。它有两个工具:列出当前可用模型;把提示发给指定模型并取回回答。
howto.when: 当你要求用 atomic chat 回答某个问题,或让它列出本地模型、调用指定本地模型时触发;前提是 Atomic Chat 已安装并在 1337 端口开启本地 API。

say.text: 用 atomic chat 告诉我法国的首都是哪里
say.note: 先列出模型,再调用其中一个生成回答

say.text: 先列出 Atomic Chat 里现在能用哪些模型
用 atomic_chat_generate 让 llama3.2 回答
say.note: 模型 ID 需与列表工具返回的一致

howto.what_en: After install, Claude can hand tasks to local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app: it can list the available models and send a prompt to a chosen model to get a reply.
howto.when_en: When you ask to use atomic chat to answer something, or to list local models / call a specific local model. Requires Atomic Chat installed with its local API server running on port 1337.

say_en.text: use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Agent lists models, then generates with one

say_en.text: list the models currently available in Atomic Chat
use atomic_chat_generate with llama3.2 to answer
say_en.note: Model ID must match the listed IDs
